title: SmartBear MCP
name: com.smartbear/smartbear-mcp
description: MCP server for AI access to SmartBear tools, including BugSnag, Reflect, Swagger, PactFlow, QTM4J.

environmentVariables.name: BEARQ_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: BearQ workspace API token. Leave empty to disable BearQ tools.

environmentVariables.name: BEARQ_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the BearQ public API base URL. Defaults to https://api.bearq.smartbear.com.

environmentVariables.name: BUGSNAG_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: BugSnag auth token. Leave empty to disable BugSnag tools.

environmentVariables.name: BUGSNAG_PROJECT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: BugSnag project API key. Optional; narrows interactions to a single project.

environmentVariables.name: REFLECT_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Reflect API token. Leave empty to disable Reflect tools.

environmentVariables.name: SWAGGER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Swagger API key. Leave empty to disable Swagger tools.

environmentVariables.name: PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: PactFlow or Pact Broker base URL. Leave empty to disable Pact tools.

environmentVariables.name: PACT_BROKER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: PactFlow authentication token.

environmentVariables.name: PACT_BROKER_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Pact Broker username. Alternative to token authentication.

environmentVariables.name: PACT_BROKER_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Pact Broker password. Alternative to token authentication.

environmentVariables.name: QMETRY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: QMetry Open API key. Leave empty to disable QMetry tools.

environmentVariables.name: QMETRY_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: QMetry base URL. Defaults to https://testmanagement.qmetry.com.

environmentVariables.name: ZEPHYR_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Zephyr Cloud API token for authentication.

environmentVariables.name: ZEPHYR_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Zephyr Cloud API base URL. Override for a region-specific endpoint if needed.

environmentVariables.name: COLLABORATOR_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Collaborator base URL.

environmentVariables.name: COLLABORATOR_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Collaborator username.

environmentVariables.name: COLLABORATOR_LOGIN_TICKET
environmentVariables.description: Collaborator login ticket.

environmentVariables.name: QTM4J_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: QTM4J API key. Leave empty to disable QTM4J tools.

environmentVariables.name: QTM4J_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: QTM4J base URL. Defaults to https://qtmcloud.qmetry.com.

environmentVariables.name: QTM4J_AUTOMATION_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: QTM4J Automation API key used by automation import tools.
